design.quote: secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial.

population.quote: Adults aged 25-75 y with obesity (BMI: 30-60 kg/m2) undergoing weight-loss treatment were randomized to eat in an 8-h period from 07:00 to 15:00 (eTRE) or over a ≥12-h period (control) for 14 wk.
population.value: Adults aged 25-75 y with obesity (BMI: 30-60 kg/m2) undergoing weight-loss treatment

intervention.quote: eat in an 8-h period from 07:00 to 15:00 (eTRE)

primary_findings.quote: eTRE lowered diastolic blood pressure by 9 ± 4 mm Hg (P = 0.047) in adults with systolic blood pressure ≥130 mm Hg relative to the control group.
primary_findings.outcome: diastolic blood pressure change in adults with systolic blood pressure ≥130 mm Hg

primary_findings.quote: eTRE lowered diastolic blood pressure by 4 ± 2 mm Hg (P = 0.04) in adults with hypertension relative to the control group.
primary_findings.outcome: diastolic blood pressure change in adults with hypertension

primary_findings.quote: eTRE lowered hemoglobin A1c by 0.3% ± 0.1% (P = 0.04) in prediabetic adults.
primary_findings.outcome: hemoglobin A1c change in prediabetic adults

primary_findings.quote: eTRE reduced HOMA-IR by 2.96 ± 1.46 (P = 0.04) in adults with hypercholesterolemia.
primary_findings.outcome: HOMA-IR change in adults with hypercholesterolemia

primary_findings.quote: eTRE increased total and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol by 21 ± 9 and 17 ± 7 mg/dL, respectively (P = 0.03).
primary_findings.outcome: total cholesterol change in adults with severe obesity
